summaries.summary: The image displays a flowchart detailing the workflow of an online display advertising campaign across various roles including Advertiser, Media Director/Supervisor, Media Planner, Creative Agency/RM, Sales Rep, Account Manager, Tech Team, and Publisher Ad Server. It outlines steps from brainstorming and RFP responses to campaign launch, tag confirmation, delivery, and reporting. A large text overlay states 'ONLINE DISPLAY HID SERIOUS INEFFICIENCIES', with the source cited as 'Rubicon Project'.
key_facts: The flowchart illustrates the end-to-end process of an online display advertising campaign.
The campaign workflow involves multiple stakeholders including Advertiser, Media Director, Creative Agency, Sales Rep, Account Manager, Tech Team, and Publisher Ad Server.
The text overlay indicates that online display advertising 'hid serious inefficiencies'.
The source of the information is the 'Rubicon Project'.
